ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white/light-grey pixels dominate approximately 88% of the visible ventral area, with low-intensity black pixels concentrated at the trailing edges and the basal insertion point.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity regions across both lobes; low-intensity black pixels form an irregular, high-frequency border along the trailing edges and a dense, blotchy cluster at the center-bottom base. A singular, isolated dark circular spot is visible on the medial portion of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation; approximately 55-degree internal angle with a deep vertical penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations along the entire trailing boundary; extreme jaggedness with multiple sharp peaks and irregular valleys, particularly prominent at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edges sweeping upwards to sharp distal tips; trailing edges follow a complex concave-to-convex trajectory towards the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular pockmarks and low-relief indentations visible across the central surfaces of both lobes; dense high-contrast white clusters (barnacle colonies) are present on the distal-most tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe irregular topography and high-contrast scarring on the distal tips suggesting significant temporal wear or physical trauma; pervasive circular pockmarks across the fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique singular dark circular pigmentation focal point on the inner-medial region of the left lobe.
